# Eric Onah

> Eric Onah is a full-stack developer specializing in WordPress, headless CMS architectures, React, and Next.js. This is his professional portfolio, with project examples, experience, articles, and contact information.

The public portfolio is at https://ericonah.online/. It uses a Next.js frontend with content managed in WordPress. The pages below provide current details about Eric's work and professional background.

## Portfolio

- [Home](https://ericonah.online/): Professional introduction, skills, experience highlights, and selected work.
- [About](https://ericonah.online/about): Professional background, experience, education, and resume access.
- [Projects](https://ericonah.online/projects): Project examples and links to individual project details.
- [Posts](https://ericonah.online/posts): Published articles; follow each article's link for its full content.
- [Contact](https://ericonah.online/contact): Current contact information and project inquiry form.

## Optional

- [GitHub](https://github.com/EricOnah): Public code repositories.
- [LinkedIn](https://linkedin.com/in/eric-onah/): Professional profile.
